title: The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not perform a capability or nonce check on an AJAX action available…
description: The Flatsome WordPress theme versions prior to 3.20.13 contain a vulnerability where an AJAX action accessible to unauthenticated users lacks capability and nonce checks. This flaw allows unauthorized users to retrieve content from unpublished posts, including drafts and pending posts, by specifying post IDs.
